Messages.Author: Rui Videira
Messages.Body:
Hello,

If I try to use an aggravated damage strike against a vampire with a Heart
of
Darkness card on him or her, can I play then a Roetschreck to send her to
torpor?

Thanks in advance,
Rui

Messages.Author: Tim Eijpe
Messages.Body:
>===== Original Message From Rui Videira <vid...@MailAndNews.com> =====

>Hello,
>
>If I try to use an aggravated damage strike against a vampire with a Heart
>of
>Darkness card on him or her, can I play then a Roetschreck to send her to
>torpor?
>
>Thanks in advance,
>Rui

Yes. The *key* word in Rotschreck is "attempts to inflict aggrevated damage"
<at close range>. Prevention/damage changing does not matter.
The strike resolution phase and resulting damage dealing phase of the combat
is not reached. The opposing acting vampire will enter torpor before
strikes.
(Except when playing a OOT malkavian rush deck, then the acting minion
should
be reacting/vampire in combat)

Tim Eijpe

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Tim Eijpe wrote:
> >===== Original Message From Rui Videira <vid...@MailAndNews.com> =====

> >If I try to use an aggravated damage strike against a vampire with a Heart
> >of
> >Darkness card on him or her, can I play then a Roetschreck to send her to
> >torpor?
>

> Yes. The *key* word in Rotschreck is "attempts to inflict aggrevated damage"
> <at close range>. Prevention/damage changing does not matter.
> The strike resolution phase and resulting damage dealing phase of the combat
> is not reached. The opposing acting vampire will enter torpor before
> strikes.

Correct, except for the "at close range" part. That part should be "on the
vampire". If the minion attempts to inflict agg damage on the vampire, even
if range is long, Rotschreck can be played.

If you attempt to use a non-range agg strike when the range is long, Rotschreck
can't be played, sinc ethe non-ranged strike isn't "against" the opposing
vampire - it's just against the air in front him.
